_notes.purpose: Sample listing photos for demo listings while the portal has no real sellers. Every listing that shows them is demo data; they are never attached to a listing that has real photos.
_notes.model: gpt_image_2_5 variant sunburst, quality medium, resolution 1k, ratio 4:3 (Higgsfield MCP)
_notes.resolution_rule: 1k: listing photos render at most ~900 px wide in the gallery and ~480 px on cards, so 1168x880 native is enough; no upscaling.
_notes.ledger_checked: 2026-09-22 transactions: 10 lines 'GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst', -1 credit each, no other model
_notes.download_status: done: converted with sharp 0.35.3 to public/img/sample/listings/<file>.webp (1168 wide, q80) and <file>-thumb.webp (480 wide, q78)
_notes.attach: scripts/seed-sample-photos.ts (npm run seed:sample-photos -- --dry first) attaches these to published listings that have no photos or only remote placeholder photos, as absolute URLs so imageUrl() passes them through on every door.
